church_info.name: Turning Point Church Scottsburg
slogans: A people of second chances and new beginnings
WE ARE THE FAMILY OF GOD! YOU BELONG HERE
church_info.mission_statement: At Turning Point Church, we believe in the life-changing power of God and that His love still chases people down. We believe that God sets people free with the power of the Holy Spirit, renews their minds through the Word of God, and that salvation comes only through the name of Jesus!
church_info.affiliation: Southeastern Indiana Baptist Association (SEIBA), Southern Baptist Convention
